jobs.title: GIS Analyst II
jobs.description:
The purpose of this job is to lead and drive innovation, design, planning, and implementation of Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and related applications. This position performs the most complex tasks involving GIS analysis, database design and management, system architecture, and application development. The role also includes project management responsibilities for planning and executing projects. Additionally, this position communicates complex technical concepts clearly and effectively to non\-technical GIS users.
  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities \- The intent of this job description is to provide a representative summary of the major duties and responsibilities performed by employees in this job. Employees may be requested to perform job\-related tasks other than those specifically presented in this description**
* Performs complex data analysis using ArcGIS software, related extensions, relational databases, and other computer software.

  

* Designs, develops, and maintains GIS and relational databases in multiple formats to support organizational needs.

  

* Creates and implements custom GIS applications for both desktop and web environments.

  

* Collaborates with stakeholders to define requirements and deliver meaningful, data\-driven reports, maps, and visualizations.

  

* Leads team efforts to identify and implement effective approaches for project completion.

  

* Assists with project management activities.

  

* Communicates complex technical concepts clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing, to non\-technical users.

  

* Provides coaching and technical training to staff.

  

* Creates and maintains technical records and standard operating procedures.

  

* Regular attendance is a necessary and essential function.

  

* Performs other duties as assigned

  

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
No supervisory authority. Work requires providing guidance and training to others. This position may oversee work quality, training, instructions, and work assignments.
  

**Human Collaboration and Job Impact \- This area describes the personal interaction with others outside direct reporting relationships as well as the impact the job has on organization, the department or unit objectives, the output of services, or employee or public satisfaction**
* Interactions and communications may result in recommendations regarding policy development and implementation. May also evaluate customer satisfaction, develop cooperative associations, and utilize resources to continuously improve customer satisfaction.

  

* Interactions have significant impact on the organization in terms of time, money, or public/employee relations.

  

**Fiscal Responsibility**
* Position has limited responsibility.

  

* May assist in the collection of data in support of recommendations for departmental budget allocations. May monitor work unit or program/promotional level budget and expenditures.

  

**Education and Experience \- An equivalent combination of education, training and experience will be considered**
**Education and Experience*** Bachelor’s Degree in Geography, Computer Science, GIS, or related filed.

  

* 5 to 7 years’ experience with enterprise GIS systems.


  

**Licenses or Certifications**
* Valid driver’s license

  

* Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) certification within one year of hire.

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities which may be representative, but not all\-inclusive of those commonly associated with this position**
**Knowledge of:*** ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Pro, Python, JSON, XML, PowerShell, Structured Query Language (SQL) and Arcade.

  

* Experience Builder, Dashboards, Survey123 and Field Maps.

  

* Utility Network data model/framework.

  

* Imagery and LIDAR processing.

  

* Best practices and current trends in geospatial technologies, spatial databases, cartography and ADA compliance.

  

* Agile work methodologies.

 **Skill in:*** Communicating verbally and in writing to meet the needs of the audience.

  

* Applying active listening and asking questions for understanding.

  

* Collecting, organizing, and analyzing complex and/or technical data.

 **Ability to:*** Direct and perform high\-level GIS functions using multiple GIS software products – including ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Pro.

  

* Design data schemas, system integrations and ETL processes.

  

* Create and utilize networks, datasets, and programs for analysis, modelling and planning.

  

* Develop and maintain applications using technologies including ArcGIS Experience Builder, JavaScript, Python, Arcade and HTML.

  

* Compile, organize, interpret, and communicate data and results concisely.

  

* Apply logic and reasoning to evaluate the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.

  

* Provide guidance and training to others.

  

* Provide high levels of effective customer service.

  

* Establish and maintain effective working relationships.

  

* Troubleshoot complex processes and systems.

  

* Identify and distinguish colors.

  

* Regularly use a computer, software, phone and related office equipment.

  

* Focus on tasks.

  

* Pass a Criminal Justice Information Services background check

**Work** **Environment:**  

Office or similar indoor environment – Frequently/Often

jobs.title: Corporate Land GIS Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Family Group:
Procurement \& Supply Chain Management Group
Job Description:
bpx energy, a major oil and gas producer in the United States, leverages its expertise in unconventional gas, including shale, to deliver hydrocarbon production and technical knowledge worldwide. With operations in Texas and Louisiana, our US onshore business has become both a premier oil and gas producer and a leader in reducing methane emissions.
As part of BP, a global industry leader, we foster a high\-energy, high\-intensity environment built on accountability, collegiality, innovation, and empowerment. At bpx, we support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and challenging environment where collaboration, continuous improvement, and inclusion are valued.
Discover your place with us and help our business meet the challenges of reimagining and reinventing the future of energy.
Role Synopsis
The Corporate Land GIS Analyst maintains accurate spatial records for company land agreements in an ESRI\-based environment. This role converts land records, agreement data, legal descriptions, plats, and related source information into reliable GIS polygons used for planning, development, due diligence, compliance, and business decision\-making.
The position requires foundational GIS mapping skills, careful data validation, and a technology\-forward mindset. The analyst will receive opportunities to expand technical capability in GIS applications, automation, data integration, and approved AI tools while supporting Land Compliance workflows.
Key Accountabilities
GIS Mapping and Data Management
Create, edit, validate, and maintain GIS polygons for leases, units, easements, rights\-of\-way, surface agreements, and other land\-related assets.
Interpret legal descriptions, plats, tract information, and land records to support accurate spatial mapping.
Maintain GIS features, attributes, metadata, and related records in the company’s ArcGIS environment.
Perform QA/QC between mapped features, land systems, acreage records, and supporting documents.
Support recurring data reconciliation and quality\-control processes.
Technology Support
Develop and maintain GIS applications, dashboards, and web\-based solutions that support Land Compliance workflows.
Design, build, and support FME Form and FME Flow workflows for data integration, validation, automation, and reporting.
Develop and maintain ArcGIS Experience Builder applications and ArcGIS Dashboards.
Publish and maintain GIS services, web maps, and ArcGIS Pro projects used across the business.
Partner with Land, GIS, and Technology teams to identify opportunities for process improvement and innovation.
Use approved AI tools to improve research, documentation, QA/QC, workflow efficiency, and productivity.
Land Compliance Support
Provide limited support for agreement setup, data validation, obligation research, acreage analysis, reporting, and audit readiness as needed.
Essential Experience and Eduction
Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geography, Geomatics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
3\+ years of GIS experience supporting land, energy, real estate, infrastructure, or a related industry.
Experience with ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Experience or ArcGIS Online, and enterprise GIS environments.
Experience developing ArcGIS Experience Builder applications and ArcGIS Dashboards.
Experience developing and supporting FME Form and FME Flow workflows for automation, integration, QA/QC, and reporting.
Experience publishing and maintaining feature services, web maps, and related GIS content.
Ability to interpret land records, legal descriptions, plats, tract information, and related source documents.
Experience using approved AI tools, such as Microsoft Copilot or Claude, to improve workflow efficiency and productivity.
Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
Desirable Criteria
Oil and gas land experience, including leases, units, easements, rights\-of\-way, acreage, ownership, or land administration.
Experience with Python, ArcPy, SQL, or similar scripting and query technologies.
Experience integrating GIS with land systems, reporting platforms, and enterprise databases.
Experience supporting enterprise GIS applications and business\-process automation.
Compensation \& Benefits
How much do we pay (Base)?
$87,000\-$102,000
Note that the pay range listed for this position is a good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible base compensation at the time of posting.
We offer a reward and wellbeing package designed to support your life both inside and outside of work. Benefits may include:
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Paid time off
Discretionary annual bonus program
Long\-term incentive program
401(k) matching program
Legal authorization requirements:
Must be legally authorized to work full\-time in the United States for any employer other than your current employer
Must not require sponsorship now or in the future for employment visa status (e.g., H\-1B, TN, etc.)
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other employment benefits and privileges. Please contact us to request accommodations.
Travel Requirement:
Up to 10% travel should be expected with this role
Relocation Assistance:
This role is not eligible for relocation
Remote Type:
This position is not available for remote working

jobs.title: Assistant Planner / Wedding Day Assistant
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Day of Wedding Assistant

**Location:** Sevierville, Tennessee

**Job Type:** Part Time

**Company Overview:**  
Devynn Crawford Events is a premier wedding planning company specializing in creating unforgettable and unique experiences for couples. We are looking for a passionate, detail\-oriented Assistant Wedding Planner to join our team and help make each couple’s big day run smoothly.

**Job Description:**  
Do you enjoy fast\-paced, joyful environments and love being part of memorable celebrations? We're seeking **day\-of wedding assistants** to support our planning team during weddings and special events. This is a great opportunity for dependable, detail\-oriented individuals who thrive in event settings.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Assist with setup of ceremony and reception spaces (tables, chairs, décor, signage, etc.)
* Support wedding planner with vendor coordination and event logistics
* Greet and guide guests as needed
* Help manage timeline and transitions throughout the event
* Handle last\-minute changes or needs with professionalism
* Assist with breakdown and clean\-up post\-event

**Requirements:**

* Must be punctual, reliable, and able to work independently or on a team
* Comfortable standing and moving for long periods (6–12 hours per event)
* Available on weekends and evenings (especially Fridays–Sundays)
* Positive attitude and polished appearance
* Experience in hospitality or events a plus, but not required

**Benefits:**

* Flexible working schedule
* Opportunity for career advancement in the wedding and event planning industry.
* Hands\-on experience working with experienced planners and vendors.

**How to Apply:**  
Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your experience and why you’re interested in this position to info@dcrawfordevents.com. We look forward to hearing from you!

Job Type: Part\-time

Pay: From $15\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Ability to Commute:

* Sevierville, TN 37862 (Preferred)

Ability to Relocate:

* Sevierville, TN 37862: Relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Willingness to travel:

* 25% (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

**Job Title:** Day of Wedding Assistant

**Location:** Sevierville, Tennessee

**Job Type:** Part Time

**Company Overview:**  
Devynn Crawford Events is a premier wedding planning company specializing in creating unforgettable and unique experiences for couples. We are looking for a passionate, detail\-oriented Assistant Wedding Planner to join our team and help make each couple’s big day run smoothly.

**Job Description:**  
Do you enjoy fast\-paced, joyful environments and love being part of memorable celebrations? We're seeking **day\-of wedding assistants** to support our planning team during weddings and special events. This is a great opportunity for dependable, detail\-oriented individuals who thrive in event settings.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Assist with setup of ceremony and reception spaces (tables, chairs, décor, signage, etc.)
* Support wedding planner with vendor coordination and event logistics
* Greet and guide guests as needed
* Help manage timeline and transitions throughout the event
* Handle last\-minute changes or needs with professionalism
* Assist with breakdown and clean\-up post\-event

**Requirements:**

* Must be punctual, reliable, and able to work independently or on a team
* Comfortable standing and moving for long periods (6–12 hours per event)
* Available on weekends and evenings (especially Fridays–Sundays)
* Positive attitude and polished appearance
* Experience in hospitality or events a plus, but not required

**Benefits:**

* Flexible working schedule
* Opportunity for career advancement in the wedding and event planning industry.
* Hands\-on experience working with experienced planners and vendors.

**How to Apply:**  
Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your experience and why you’re interested in this position to info@dcrawfordevents.com. We look forward to hearing from you!
